name: PDF to Text Webhook API for apps and automations

parameters.content:
# PDF-to-Text Webhook

POST `{ "url": "https://example.com/doc.pdf" }` to this endpoint. It returns clean text, metadata, and OCR metrics in real time.

## Setup (once)

**1. Get an Apify token** — https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations

**2. Create the n8n credential**
Credentials → New → **Header Auth**
- Name: `Apify API`
- Header name: `Authorization`
- Header value: `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`

Every HTTP node here points at that credential by name. No token is stored in this file.

## Cost

Pay-per-event: $0.002 per PDF that returns text (from $2.00 per 1,000). Broken links, 404s, and empty PDFs are free. OCR for scanned pages is $0.005 per page.

Current pricing: https://apify.com/sumitr_mardy/pdf-text-extractor/pricing

Actor: https://apify.com/sumitr_mardy/pdf-text-extractor
Templates & docs: https://github.com/sumitrmardy/pdf-text-extractor-api
